name: Overhead crane
description: Pre-use checks, pendant and remote controls, slinging basics, safe travel of loads and what to do when a lift goes wrong.

name: Forklift truck
description: For new and experienced operators. Stability, pre-use inspection, stacking and de-stacking, loading vehicles and working around pedestrians.

name: Telehandler
description: Load charts, reach and stability, rough ground, attachments and placing loads at height on site.

name: Cherry picker
description: Boom-type mobile elevating work platforms: setting up, harness use, overhead hazards, emergency lowering and rescue planning.

name: Scissor lift
description: Vertical platforms: ground conditions, safe working load, guardrails, travelling raised and emergency lowering.

name: Working at height awareness
description: The avoid, prevent, minimise hierarchy, ladders and steps, fragile surfaces, edge protection and falling objects.

name: Confined space awareness
description: How to recognise a confined space, why people die in them, atmospheres, permits and why untrained rescue kills rescuers.

name: Abrasive wheels
description: Wheel markings and speeds, inspection and the ring test, mounting, guarding, dressing and the right PPE.

name: Construction Safety Pass (CSP)
description: QTA's accredited site safety course for anyone going onto a construction site: legal duties, common site hazards, behaviour and reporting.

name: 10 day safety manager
description: Ten days for the person who will own safety in a business: law, risk management, policies, inspections, incident investigation and contractor control.

name: Risk assessor: general
description: Carry out and record suitable and sufficient workplace risk assessments, and keep them live.

name: Risk assessor: fire
description: Carry out a structured fire risk assessment of simple premises and write an action plan a fire officer will accept.

name: Risk assessor: construction
description: Task and site-specific assessments, method statements and the duties each party holds on a project.

name: Risk assessor: environmental
description: Identify how a site can harm land, air and water, including spills, waste, drainage and discharges, and control it.

name: Basic instructor
description: For skilled people who need to train others: lesson planning, demonstration, coaching, fair assessment and record keeping. Accredited through UK PAAS.

name: Level 3 Diploma in Instructing
description: The full route to instructing as a profession, building on the basic course with course design, quality assurance and assessment practice.
